topics.title: The Business of Building a Business
topics.hook: Most businesses don't fail for lack of passion. They fail for lack of a system.
topics.description: What it actually takes to turn an idea into a business that pays you: offers, pricing, operations, people and cash. Built from the experience of starting a service business from one small room and growing it in public.
takeaways: How to tell a hobby from a business in one honest question
Pricing that covers your time, your costs and your growth
The simple systems that stop a business depending on you for everything

topics.title: The Psychology of Selling
topics.hook: People don't buy products. They buy the version of themselves the product promises.
topics.description: Why people say yes, why they hesitate, and how to sell without begging or pressure. A practical look at trust, objections, timing and the small signals that move a buyer.
takeaways: The real reasons customers say 'let me think about it'
How to talk about price with confidence

topics.title: Marketing in the Attention Economy
topics.hook: Followers are not customers. Attention is only useful if you know what to do with it.
topics.description: How small businesses can earn attention online and convert it into paying customers, using content, storytelling and positioning rather than big budgets.
takeaways: Content that builds trust, not just views
Positioning so you stop competing on price
A simple path from viewer to buyer

topics.title: From Skill to Sustainable Business
topics.hook: A skill pays you once. A business pays you while you sleep.
topics.description: For people who are good at something and want to be paid properly for it. How to package a skill into a service, price it, find the first customers and grow beyond yourself.
takeaways: Packaging a skill into a clear offer
When and how to hire your first helper

topics.title: Women, Wealth and Entrepreneurship
topics.hook: A woman with a skill is talented. A woman who can sell her skill is free.
topics.description: Financial independence is not a mindset. It is a skill set. A practical, honest conversation about women, money and building businesses, including with limited resources and heavy responsibilities.
takeaways: Why financial dependence is a business problem, not a personal failure
Starting with what you have, not what you wish you had
Building income that fits a full life

topics.title: Customer Acquisition and Business Growth
topics.hook: You don't have a sales problem. You have a 'nobody knows you exist' problem.
topics.description: Where customers really come from, how to keep them, and how to grow without burning money. Practical channels for service businesses, from word of mouth to social media.
takeaways: Mapping where your best customers come from
Retention: the cheapest growth there is
Simple numbers every owner should track
